insight: Raised $10M led by Prosperity7 (~$25M total in under a year) and reached 200K users within months of its Sept 2025 launch.
name: Creao AI
tagline: No-code 'Super Agent' that builds and runs autonomous workflow apps from plain English.
description: Creao AI is a no-code platform whose 'Super Agent' turns a plain-language request into a working app: it writes the logic, calls APIs, and runs the task in a sandbox. Successful workflows lock into reusable 'Agent Apps' that run on a schedule 24/7 without further AI involvement, which avoids hallucination on repeat runs. It connects to 15+ services (Gmail, Google Sheets, GitHub, Slack, Notion) and can learn new integrations from supplied API docs.

modelSupport.notes: Builds on frontier LLMs; the Pro plan adds access to the latest frontier models.

edge: Closes the loop — the agent both builds the tool and runs it on a schedule, turning one-off chats into persistent apps that execute without re-prompting.
pros: Build full apps/workflows in plain English
Runs tasks autonomously in a sandbox
